description: This file defines synchronization utilities for managing API locks, including thread-local flags, lock guards, and registration functions for API methods within a C++ project. It includes template classes and functions to handle locking mechanisms, API registration, and thread safety in a multi-threaded environment.

classes.name: ApiLocks
classes.description: Template struct that maintains a static recursive mutex for each class type to ensure thread-safe API locking.

classes.name: UnlockApiGuard
classes.description: Template RAII guard that unlocks the mutex upon construction if the thread is using the locked API, and re-locks it upon destruction.

classes.name: LockApiGuard
classes.description: RAII guard that manages locking and unlocking of the mutex for a specific class type.

methods.name: getFunctionToCall
methods.description: Creates a std::function wrapper around a member function, managing locking and thread-local flags for API calls.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApi
methods.description: Registers a method with the JSONRPC system, associating it with an object and ensuring thread safety.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForVersions
methods.description: Registers a method with versioning support for the JSONRPC system.

methods.name: RegisterLockedApiForHandler
methods.description: Registers a method with a JSONRPC handler object.
